name: Health
short_desc: View: your recovery, sleep and activity from connected wearables such as WHOOP, in plain sentences, every day as a square like a GitHub graph.
author: Humanity Labs
description: A health tracker over the wearables you connect (WHOOP today, more later). Recovery, Sleep and Activity each get a card with a big number, a coloured word and one plain sentence (Why? opens the last 30 days and the numbers behind it), above a GitHub-style graph of every day; tap a day to see it. Wide windows show all three side by side; on a phone a bottom bar picks one. Health reads connector apps through the health-data contract and never holds a wearable's keys. Your agent gets read-only tools for the same data.
